items.label: VexCgmLabs
items.purpose: Create a source-backed medical-mobile CGM practicum whose synthetic device, Android consumer and later BLE realization preserve acquisition/observation continuity, currentness and traceability without making transport, UI, cloud or security alternate CGM semantic owners.

items.label: Prove the Partner / Signal / Store / Family circuit
items.purpose: Accepted VexLife-Android PR #219 / merge 7800c17909fd03d1170ec0211a6632172c87d1af closes the bounded Partner / Signal / Store / Family proof: Partner Source / Signal / Connection / Conversion / Observation / suspend Receiver, dual BLE-like and HTTP-like provider forms, queued admission, generated Room v6 persistence/restart reconstruction, Family outbound pump requests and cross-Family feedback are accepted source. Merged VexWork PR #281 / 776932d2a8cc27ea05b77dc2db320789138a2cdc keeps the current source-epoch Screen Lens projection aligned while historical Stable remains historical. Real Local HTTP/BLE lifecycle and deeper CGM continuity remain separate Work items.

items.label: Define the synthetic CGM Signal and retained-history contract
items.purpose: Form the smallest transport-neutral synthetic device contract that can emit the same CGM Signal vocabulary through Local HTTP first and BLE later, including current session metadata, live observations, retained-history frontier and exact replay relationships while keeping Lab-only mutation controls separate from the consumer contract.

items.label: Build the VexCgmLabs synthetic device workbench
items.purpose: Use the CGM, Insulin and consolidated Partners Circuit Screens from VexLife-Android PR #219 as human-visible architecture fixtures. Live CGM/Partners Debug construction uses Room-backed CgmStore while previews remain in-memory. The CGM surface now exposes separate BLE-like and HTTP-like provider controls that differ at Conversion/Connection occurrence but converge into the same Partner Source/Signal vocabulary, Store and CgmFamily. The lab also shows queued Connection admission, source-addressed Store listeners, Family-authored queued Pump Effects, and the CgmFamily-State -> InsulinFamily-Control -> Pump Partner feedback loop. VexBoard PR #276 projects these relationships without changing currentness authority.

items.label: Realize the synthetic CGM device over a Local HTTP Connection
items.purpose: Provide the first easy-to-control concrete Connection realization for the synthetic CGM Signal/history contract so semantic scenarios can run before BLE hardware exists, while keeping Lab controls distinct from the consumer-facing Connection.

items.label: Realize the Android transport-neutral CGM Partner Connection seam
items.purpose: Pressure the accepted VexPartner.Connection boundary with real transport realization. Merged Android #219 proves Connection.Conversion<Input, Partner, Signal>: synthetic BLE-like bytes and an HTTP-like body produce equal CGM Partner Signals while keeping distinct Connection occurrence, then converge on the same Observation / suspend Receiver / Store / Family circuit. Next replace the synthetic forms with concrete Local HTTP and/or BLE lifecycle/provider input without moving Partner Source/Signal meaning, Store durability or Family State into transport.

items.label: Implement durable CGM Signal continuity and integrity reconciliation
items.purpose: Build from the accepted Room/restart Store patient zero now on Android main: explicit cgm_partner_observation rows preserve Partner source/epoch/sequence plus Connection occurrence provenance; restoration reconstructs historical Observation/Signal values into CgmStore and CgmFamily without Decoder/Receiver replay; the synthetic source resumes at the next durable sequence. Android #219 accepted the generated Room v6 schema and bounded connected synthetic restart proof. Next deepen CGM-specific duplicate/conflict/gap/retention/checkpoint rules and atomic multi-row invariants where the scenarios require them.

items.label: Build the Android CGM semantic/product projection
items.purpose: Use rightful VexArchitecture owners to derive current/stale/recovering/unavailable product meaning and DisplayState from durable CGM history, Connection truth and admitted Signals without duplicating canonical measurement values into parallel UI models or equating connection availability with measurement currentness.

items.label: Prove source-backed Design Trace on CGM requirements
items.purpose: Bind the synthetic CGM design inputs to candidate implementation patterns, actual source owners, verification scenarios and exact evidence so requirement-to-code-to-proof traversal is generated from source relationships rather than a parallel manual trace matrix.

items.label: Replace the Local HTTP Connection with a BLE realization
items.purpose: Implement a BLE CGM Connection that emits the same admitted CGM Signal vocabulary and prove equivalent continuity/integrity and semantic results for the G01-G30 device events, with discovery/GATT/characteristic/reconnect mechanics remaining concrete realization rather than CGM meaning.

items.label: Integrate CGM history with Cloud Connectivity
items.purpose: Use the Cloud Connectivity contracts to pressure offline/durable CGM history upload, backfill provenance, idempotency, currentness and multi-device synchronization without moving CGM acquisition meaning into cloud/service owners.

items.label: Integrate CGM device/service security pressure
items.purpose: Use Full Security to pressure device/service identity, possession/admission, protected operations and evidence around the CGM relationship without treating security truth as acquisition, transport continuity or glucose semantics.

items.label: Project CGM behavior, depth, Design Trace and verification through VexBoard
items.purpose: Use the accepted VexBoard Partner projector from merged PR #276 / e24af6945eb8560c63070b2e32bb43913c042fba and source-epoch Screen Lens currentness from merged PR #281 / 776932d2a8cc27ea05b77dc2db320789138a2cdc against accepted Android Partner source from merged PR #219 / 7800c17909fd03d1170ec0211a6632172c87d1af. The consolidated source yields six PARTNER_CIRCUIT pathways, zero held controls and twelve overlap-free Behavior/Depth layouts; BLE-like and HTTP-like CGM paths differ only at concrete Conversion and Connection occurrence while sharing Source/Signal/Store/Family meaning. The old Android-acceptance/currentness hold is satisfied. This Work remains WAITING_DEPENDENCIES only on its still-open Design Trace and Android CGM product Work dependencies; projector acceptance does not collapse those owners.

transitions.reason: VexLife-Android PR #219 merged as 7800c17909fd03d1170ec0211a6632172c87d1af after exact-head SourceOwner PASS, fresh Independent Assurance CLEAR, generated Room-v6 source proof and a bounded connected synthetic Room-restart PASS. VexWork PR #281 merged as 776932d2a8cc27ea05b77dc2db320789138a2cdc, keeping current source-epoch Screen Lens projection aligned without promoting historical Stable. The bounded Partner / Signal / Store / Family foundation predicate is therefore satisfied; real provider lifecycle and deeper CGM/product work remain separately open.
